headline: France to share files on 1980 Ustica plane crash
standfirst: New documents could finally explain why a passenger jet crashed near Italy decades ago.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: France is sharing defense files with Italian judges about a 1980 passenger jet crash.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: A former Italian president claimed a French fighter jet accidentally shot the plane down.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These files might finally confirm or disprove the theory that a stray missile caused the tragedy.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Italian investigators will now review the documents to see if they hold any new evidence.

caption:
France is releasing defense documents related to the 1980 Ustica plane crash investigation.

For decades, the crash has been a mystery, with theories pointing toward an accidental missile strike. While some remain skeptical about what the files will reveal, this cooperation marks a significant step forward.

Do you think these old files will finally provide closure for the families involved?
